This '''bar patron''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] who was present in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of [[Maz Kanata]] on [[Takodana]] when the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] the [[planet]].<ref name="VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by [[Marina Hayter]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. Her role was not listed in the end credits.
